title: Answer: measurement reads finite bits from a boundary

statements.text: Measurement is an observer reading a finite string of bits from its holographic screen through a quantum reference frame and writing it to memory at a thermodynamic cost. It is always active and always relative to that observer.

sources.quote: The goal of measurement is to obtain recordable, reportable observational outcomes that can be compared to the outcomes of measurements carried out at other times or by other observers.
